about: What a wikilink target names (M55.8). A name resolves by filename stem first, then by the folder of a project.md, then by exact title, all case-insensitive and trimmed, each pass taking the first entry in order; an empty name resolves nothing. A target is read whole first. Only when that names nothing and the target holds a #, the text before its FIRST # is resolved as the page, and the text after it, trimmed, is the section (none when empty). So nothing that resolved before section links changes, and a title that holds a # stays a title link. The fragment is never cut from the file or from outgoingLinks. Replayed by replays_the_shared_target_cases in src-tauri/src/vault/link.rs, which checks path only, and by src/engine/wikilink.test.ts, which checks path and section. `why` is for the reader.

cases.why: A project is reached by its folder, and the folder outranks a page titled Atlas.
The page before the #, the heading after it.
The page half runs the folder pass like any name.
The page half runs the title pass like any name.
The whole target goes first, so a title that holds a # stays a title link.
An empty section is none: the link reaches the page.
No page half: it names a section of the page the link sits in, which only that page can answer.
A page half that names nothing dangles.
Resolves to the page; the editor lands only on headings.
